notes:
Running-jobs chip: while GAM commands work, the top bar shows “1 running · 1 waiting”, or “45% 1,200 of 4,640” for one big job. Click it for each job’s progress and time, plus Stop, Stop all and Show output.
Friendly dates and values: tables show “Oct 12, 2026 (16 days ago)”, “Never” and Yes/No. Hovering shows the exact value, and exports, copying and actions still use it. The filter matches what you see, so typing “aug” works.
Org unit picker: Choose… next to an org-unit box now opens a searchable list just below it. It shows each org unit’s school, how many people are in it, and the ones you used recently at the top.
Errors on the field: a missing name or bad email gets a red outline and a short note right under the box. The note disappears as soon as you fix it.
Unsaved-changes check: if you’ve typed into Create a user, Create a group or New staff and then click another page or close GAMbit, it asks first. Only what you typed counts, not text GAMbit fills in.
Settings navigation: Settings & Updates has a section list on the left and a Find a setting… box. For example, typing “tray” shows only Appearance and safety.
Keyboard:
An outline appears when you move with Tab or the arrow keys, but not when you click.
Pressing Enter on a table row opens it.
Icon-only buttons have names for screen readers.
Copy on hover: hover an email, serial or asset tag in a table for a small copy button. The details panel has them too.
Remember where you were: GAMbit reopens on your last page, each page on its last tab, with your last Users search filled in.
Step-by-step forms:
Create a user now has Details → Groups & license → Review. Assigning a license and adding groups are new on this page.
New staff has About the person → What to set up → Review.
Review lists exactly what will happen, and Show the GAM commands shows the commands. Nothing runs until you click the button there, so the old “are you sure?” question is gone from New staff.
